name: com.coverup.mapsdk
description: Authoring SDK for Cover Up! Workshop maps: the _CoverUpMap components (MapConfig, MapSizeVariants, MapBoundsVolume, CamouflageSurface, MapSpawnDisc, WorkshopMapInfo) plus the map-size + player-scale contract, and the full editor tooling — Validate Map, Export Workshop Map, auto-export, gizmos, and the Create Example Sized Map starter. Both the shipping game and third-party map projects depend on this package, so a map bundle's component scripts bind to the game's classes by identical GUIDs. Add it to a bare URP project to author maps.
